summary: Targeted frontend regression for navigation-visibility fix in Header.jsx. Tested desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844) viewports. All required data-testids present and behave responsively: desktop category-nav visible with 8 categories + Marques/Promotions/Nouveautés/Blog/Contact links, mobile-menu-open hidden. Category link navigates to /categorie/visage. Promotions link navigates to /catalogue?on_promo=1. Mobile: 'Menu' button visible, category-nav hidden, drawer opens with all categories + Marques/Promotions/Nouveautés/Blog/Contact/Mon compte, clicking a category navigates and auto-closes drawer, close button also closes drawer. Homepage/header render fine (logo, search, phone, account, cart).
critical_code_review_comments: Two 401 errors observed on initial page load (likely /api/auth/me or similar unauthenticated probe). Not blocking but noisy in console; consider suppressing when user is not logged in.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav fix verified on desktop+mobile. All data-testids (category-nav, category-nav-{sante,visage,corps,cheveux,solaires,hygiene,maquillage,kbeauty}, mobile-menu-open, mobile-menu, mobile-menu-close) work as specified.
